_note: Wits campuses. `center`/`zoom` only set the initial map view; they are NEVER used as destinations. Destinations are team-pinned campus_places. Centres come from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim, looked up 2026-09-27); `centerSource` records what each point actually is. For Education and Health Sciences, OSM had no campus outline, so the nearest named campus feature is used as a map-view proxy. `maxPinDistanceM` rejects pins that are clearly on the wrong campus.
